stem:
Butane is treated with Br2 in the presence of light (hν) to give a major monobromo derivative X. Compound X is then reacted with AgNO2 (silver nitrite) to afford the major product Z. Which of the following is the structure of the final product Z?
Options (structures as SMILES):
(A) CCC(C)Br
(B) CCCC[N+](=O)[O-]
(C) CCC(C)[N+](=O)[O-]
(D) CCC(C)ON=O
Choose the one correct option.

3-bromo-3-methylpentane is subjected to the following sequence of reactions:

Step 1: Treatment with Zn / H+ gives compound X.
Step 2: Compound X is reacted with Br2 in the presence of light (hν) to yield compound Y as the major product.
Step 3: Compound Y is treated with Mg in dry ether to form compound Z.

The major product Z is:
Options (structures as SMILES):
(A) CC[C](C)(CC)[Mg][Br]
(B) CCC(C)(Br)CC
(C) CCC(C)C[CH2][Mg][Br]
(D) CCC(C)[CH](C)[Mg][Br]
Choose the one correct option.

Aniline is treated with Caro's acid (H2SO5) to give an intermediate X. Compound X is then reacted with a mixture of conc. HNO3 and conc. H2SO4 under stepwise increasing temperature to yield the major product Z. Which of the following represents the structure of the major product Z?
Options (structures as SMILES):
(A) O=Nc1ccccc1[N+](=O)[O-]
(B) O=Nc1cccc([N+](=O)[O-])c1
(C) O=Nc1ccccc1
(D) O=Nc1ccc([N+](=O)[O-])cc1
Choose the one correct option.

An alkane P is subjected to a sequence of functional group transformations to yield various organic intermediates and products as outlined below.
P = 2,2-dimethylpropane
P --[Br₂, hν]--> Q
Q --[CH₃ONa]--> R
R --[HI (1 equiv)]--> S
Q --[Mg, dry ether]--> T
T --[(i) CO₂ (dry ice); (ii) H₃O⁺]--> U
U --[CH₃OH, conc. H₂SO₄ (cat.), heat]--> V
V --[(i) DIBAL-H, 195 K; (ii) H₂O]--> W
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(A) The alkyl halide obtained as compound S has the molecular formula CH₃I.
(B) Compound U gives effervescence with aqueous NaHCO₃ solution.
(C) Compound W gives a positive Tollens' test.
(D) The total number of sp³-hybridized carbon atoms in one molecule of compound U is 4.
Choose all the correct options.

Consider the following sequence of organic transformations starting from propan-1-ol (P).
P = propan-1-ol
P --[SOCl₂, pyridine]--> Q
Q --[Zn, H⁺]--> R
R --[Br₂, hν]--> S
Q --[Mg, dry ether]--> T
Q --[alc. KOH, heat]--> U
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(A) The major product S formed upon monobromination is 2-bromopropane.
(B) Compound U decolourises bromine water.
(C) Compound U contains three sp²-hybridised carbon atoms.
(D) Compound S contains one stereocentre.
Choose all the correct options.

An organic reaction sequence starting from benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid (P) is shown below.
P = benzene-1,2-dicarboxylic acid
P --[(i) LiAlH₄, dry ether; (ii) H₂O]--> Q
Q --[SOCl₂, pyridine]--> R
R --[NaCN, DMSO]--> S
Q --[KMnO₄, H⁺, heat]--> T
R --[NH₃ (excess)]--> U
U --[NaNO₂, dil. HCl]--> V
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
(A) Compound T produces effervescence of CO₂ on treatment with aqueous NaHCO₃.
(B) Compound S contains exactly one sp-hybridised carbon atom.
(C) Compound U does not give a positive carbylamine test when warmed with CHCl₃ and alcoholic KOH.
(D) The degree of unsaturation of compound V is 5.
Choose all the correct options.

Propane (P) is subjected to a series of functional group transformations to yield compounds Q through U as shown below.
P = propane
P --[Br₂, hν]--> Q
Q --[DMSO, heat]--> R
R --[I₂, NaOH]--> S
R --[(i) Br₂, NaOH (excess); (ii) H₃O⁺]--> T
Q --[alc. KOH, heat]--> U
Find the number of correct statements among the following:
(1) Compound Q is 2-bromopropane.
(2) Compound R gives a positive Tollens' silver mirror test.
(3) The molecular formula of compound S is CHI₃.
(4) Compound T produces brisk effervescence with aqueous NaHCO₃ solution.
(5) Compound U decolourises bromine water.
(6) Compound R gives a yellow precipitate in the iodoform test.
Give the answer as an integer.

A sequence of organic reactions starting from 1,2-dibromopropane (P) is shown below.
P = 1,2-dibromopropane
P --[Zn dust, CH₃OH, heat]--> Q
Q --[mCPBA]--> R
R --[CH₃NH₂]--> S
R --[H₃O⁺]--> T
T --[PI₃ (excess)]--> U

(1) Compound Q decolourises bromine water.
(2) Compound R has a degree of unsaturation equal to 1.
(3) Compound S gives a positive iodoform test upon treatment with I₂ and NaOH.
(4) Compound S gives a positive carbylamine test when heated with CHCl₃ and alcoholic KOH.
(5) The total number of stereocentres present in compound T is 2.
(6) The molecular formula of compound U is C₃H₆I₂.
Give the answer as an integer.
